lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into roughly equidistant vertical columns and horizontal rows, forming a regular 2D grid posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of increased intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, acting as grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a slender, dark commensal fish (likely a remora) oriented parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis in the lower-central region of the frame.
